Question: Square pyramid \(ABCDE\) has base \(ABCD,\) which measures \(3\) cm on a side, and altitude \(\overline{AE}\) perpendicular to the base, which measures \(6\) cm. Point \(P\) lies on \(\overline{BE},\) one third of the way from \(B\) to \(E;\) point \(Q\) lies on \(\overline{DE},\) one third of the way from \(D\) to \(E;\) and point \(R\) lies on \(\overline{CE},\) two thirds of the way from \(C\) to \(E.\) What is the area, in square centimeters, of \(\triangle PQR?\)
